result.title: Intra-Architecture Source Attribution for Stable Diffusion: A New Task with Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
result.comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision(WACV 2027)
result.summary: Designing systems that attribute a generated image to its source model has lately become a major area of AI research. Most existing datasets and systems related to image source attribution are targeted towards the detection of architectural signatures of the source models. Distinct from this, focusing on stable diffusion, we introduce a novel task, IntrAA-SD, Intra-Architecture source Attribution for Stable Diffusion, where the source models to be differentiated share the same architectural backbone and differ only due to fine-tuning. The proposed task aligns with the emergence of fine-tuned generators having the same architecture, like Juggernaut XL and RealVis XL, which are fine-tuned versions of Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL). We provide a first-of-its-kind $140$K-image benchmark dataset containing images generated from different fine-tunes of SDXL, along with in-domain and out-of-distribution prompts. We also provide a baseline framework for IntrAA-SD, which leverages a style-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts network. It uses a frozen CLIP backbone to capture the image style and gate the MoE, which processes fine-tuned trace features from a high-resolution LoRA-adapted DINOv2 network. The fine-tuned models used, the prompting strategies considered, and the formation details employed in the novel dataset are elaborated. Our baseline intra-architecture source attribution method is evaluated in terms of attribution accuracy on our dataset, and ablation studies are also performed. Code and dataset is available at https://github.com/mallikagarg/IntrAA-SD.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出「IntrAA-SD」任务，即区分同一 SDXL 架构下仅经不同微调得到的生成器，并构建 14 万张图像的基准数据集，给出结合 CLIP 风格门控与 LoRA 微调 DINOv2 特征的 MoE 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是生成图像来源取证与数据集基准，不涉及内部推理状态、视觉证据获取、停止决策或 VLM 推理训练；其风格门控与指纹特征也无明确可迁移到 LVR 的具体线索，故排除。
